title: AI for Healthcare Administration
subtitle: Save hours on rosters, reports, policies, emails and meeting notes with AI productivity tools.
description: Designed for hospital and clinic administrators, managers and support teams. Learn to use AI assistants for drafting policies and SOPs, summarising meetings, preparing reports, analysing spreadsheets, writing professional emails and improving patient-facing communication — with clear rules for data protection.
audience: Hospital and clinic administrators and managers
Front-desk, HR, finance and quality staff
outcomes: Draft policies, SOPs and reports faster
Summarise meetings and long documents accurately
Analyse spreadsheets and present data clearly
Use AI in line with your organisation's data rules
prerequisites: Comfortable using email and office software

modules.title: Governance and data protection
modules.description: Rules for safe use across your organisation.
